title: California DMV Road Signs Test
description: Free California DMV road signs practice test with real sign images. Identify each sign, get instant answers and explanations.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign indicates you must keep to the right of a divider or obstruction ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: You may turn right when the light is green
You may turn left on a green light when it is safe
You may turn left when the light is green
questions.explanation: You can turn left on green, but must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: The road curves to the left
You cannot make a left turn
Left turn permitted on green arrow only
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. You must go straight or turn right.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Do not enter the road ahead unless it is safe
The road ahead is closed to all traffic
The road ahead is closed to traffic in your direction
questions.explanation: WRONG WAY sign means you're going the wrong direction.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: The road ahead is closed to traffic
You cannot enter the road from your direction
Do not enter unless it is safe
questions.explanation: 'Do Not Enter' means you cannot enter from your direction.

questions.question: There is a railroad crossing ahead. You see a mechanical signal warning you of an approaching train. You must:
options: Stop only if you see a train coming
questions.explanation: When railroad crossing signals are flashing, you must stop at least 15 feet from the tracks. Proceed only when signals stop and it's safe.

questions.question: A freeway on ramp is marked with this sign. Which of the following vehicles may use this lane?
options: A convertible with an adult and two children
A carpool van containing only the driver
A sport utility vehicle containing an adult, child, and family pet
questions.explanation: Carpool lanes (HOV lanes) can only be used if you have the minimum number of occupants shown on the posted signs. Pets do not count as passengers.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Stop only if other vehicles are present
Stop 10 feet behind the stop line
questions.explanation: STOP sign requires complete stop every time.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This warning sign indicates that the right lane ends ahead and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Another lane is merging with yours
Side road ahead on the right
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a cross road or intersection ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Vehicles on the right have the right-of-way
Give the right-of-way to cross traffic
questions.explanation: YIELD sign means give right-of-way to cross traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Right turn allowed on green arrow
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve to the right ahead.

questions.question: A yellow sign with a traffic signal symbol means:
options: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing
There is a traffic signal ahead
questions.explanation: This warning sign indicates a traffic signal is ahead. Be prepared to stop if the light is red.

questions.question: A yellow diamond-shaped sign with a black 'X' and two R's indicates:
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond with an X and two R's warns of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Pedestrians may walk in the street
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk ahead. Drivers should be prepared to slow down or stop for pedestrians.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Always drive in the right lane
Drive in the right lane if you are driving slower than traffic
questions.explanation: Slower vehicles should keep right to allow faster traffic to pass.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Another lane is merging with yours
questions.explanation: This sign warns that another lane is merging with your lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: The road ahead is closed to traffic in all directions
You cannot enter the road from your direction
Do not enter unless it is safe
questions.explanation: 'Do Not Enter' means you cannot enter from your direction.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: The road ahead is closed to traffic in all directions
Do not enter the road from your direction
You cannot enter unless it is safe
questions.explanation: 'Do Not Enter' means you cannot enter from your direction.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a rest area is 1 mile ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are approaching a divided highway. The road ahead is split by a median or divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
options: Stop only if there is cross traffic
Come to a complete stop, then proceed when safe
Slow down and yield to other traffic
questions.explanation: A red octagonal stop sign means you must come to a complete stop at the limit line and proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
options: Stop only if there is cross traffic
Slow down and prepare to yield right of way
questions.explanation: A red and white inverted triangle yield sign means you must slow down and give the right of way to oncoming or cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
options: You are heading the wrong direction on a one-way road
questions.explanation: The Wrong Way sign means you are heading the wrong direction on a one-way road. Stop safely, find a way to turn around, and reverse direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pentagon-shaped fluorescent yellow-green sign with children figures means a school zone is ahead. Reduce speed to 25 mph (CVC §22352) when school is in session.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign with a black X and "RR" letters is the advance warning for a railroad crossing. Slow down and be prepared to stop if signals activate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The slippery-when-wet sign warns of a road surface that can become hazardous when wet. Reduce speed and avoid sudden braking or sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A blue square sign with a white "H" indicates a hospital ahead. Blue service signs guide drivers to nearby services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A circular sign with a U-turn arrow crossed out by a red diagonal line means U-turns are prohibited at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
options: One way only — no left turn
questions.explanation: A circular sign with a left-turn arrow crossed out by a red diagonal line means left turns are prohibited at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow or fluorescent yellow-green diamond with a pedestrian symbol warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Drivers must yield to pedestrians at every crosswalk (CVC §21950).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond sign with a vehicle on an incline warns of a steep hill ahead. Reduce speed and consider downshifting before descending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond sign with a curving arrow indicates a winding road ahead — a series of curves in opposite directions. Reduce speed and stay in your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange diamond sign with a person holding a flag warns of a flagger (worker directing traffic) ahead. Slow down and follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Another lane is merging with your lane
questions.explanation: This sign warns that another lane is merging with yours.

questions.question: This sign means:
options: Do NOT pass unless you do not see oncoming vehicles
Don't pass unless it seems safe to do so
Don't pass other vehicles for any reason
questions.explanation: A 'Do Not Pass' sign indicates it's unsafe to pass in that area. Only pass when it's clearly safe and legal.
